description: This file contains a shell script designed for testing the behavior of 'git remote' group handling, including setup, updating remotes, and verifying fetch operations in various scenarios.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Writes a string to a file named 'mark' to indicate a test step.

methods.name: update_repo
methods.description: Updates a git repository by adding a file and committing with a message from 'mark'.

methods.name: update_repos
methods.description: Updates two repositories in sequence by calling 'update_repo' for each.

methods.name: repo_fetched
methods.description: Checks if the latest git log message matches the 'mark' value, indicating the repository was fetched.
